# dsh-keil
Keil MDK/uVision workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The model can inspect, build and flash an emb

edded project
through one tool, a JSON CLI and a small HTTP API — with an optional sidebar panel for

ct
through one tool, a JSON CLI and a small HTTP API — with an optional sidebar panel for the human.
[](LICENSE) · English | 简体中文
## The problem
Embedded firmware is built by a vendor IDE, not by an agent: the build recipe lives in a Keil `.uvpr

ojx` project, the
compiler is whichever MDK is installed, and flashing needs the IDE's debugger conf

iguration. An AI agent can read the
C sources but cannot run the loop that matters — compile, read e
rrors, fix, download — so a human relays every iteration.
`dsh-keil` exposes that loop as data: the agent asks for a build and gets JSON back — exit code, err

or/warning counts,
program size, log path and the generated HEX. Panel, CLI and HTTP route share one
core, so they cannot drift apart.
## What it does
- **User-selected project only.** Candidates are scanned and listed, never auto-picked; selection is

an explicit user
action stored per workspace.
- **Build and flash through UV4.** `-b` build, `-r` r

ebuild, `-c` clean, `-f` download; one job at a time, UV4 log
captured to a file.
- **Project tree a

nd include paths.** Groups, registered files (missing ones flagged) and the semicolon-separated
`<In

cludePath>` list, editable from panel, tool and CLI.
- **Registration edits only.** Source files, `.

uvoptx` and build output on disk are never touched; every mutation is
backed up first and written th

rough a temp file plus rename.
- **Byte-preserving XML edits.** A strict span-preserving parser spli

ces string ranges instead of re-serializing:
add-then-remove restores the file byte for byte, and BO

M/CRLF/comments survive.
- **JSON-only CLI** (`dsh-keil`, exit `0`/`1`/`2`) and an **optional "Keil"

survive.
- **JSON-only CLI** (`dsh-keil`, exit `0`/`1`/`2`) and an **optional "Keil" sidebar tab**.
## Requirements
| Requirement | Notes |
| Windows 10/11 | Build and download run `UV4.exe`, so they need Windows. Read-only inspection works

wherever Node runs. |
| Keil MDK with uVision 5 (`UV4.exe`) | Compiler, device packs and debugger s

etup come from your MDK install and the project. |
| DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` or newer | Desktop app, or a C

LI-managed profile (`web`, `tui`, …). The package is a normal DSH bundle. |
| Node.js 20 or newer |

The desktop app ships its own runtime; a standalone install needs Node 20+ (`engines`). |
| `dsh-bet
ter-sidebar` `0.28.0`+ | **Optional.** Only for the sidebar tab; tool, CLI and HTTP API do not depen
r` `0.28.0`+ | **Optional.** Only for the sidebar tab; tool, CLI and HTTP API do not depend on it. |
## Installation
Install the bundle from this directory and always pass an **absolute spec** (`file:` plus a forward-

slash absolute
path). A relative spec resolves against whatever directory the package manager runs i

n, not against the checkout, so
it silently fails to find the plugin.
### 1. CLI-managed DSH profile (fastest)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plain `dsh` CLI needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (the desktop carrier CLI bundles its own). The command in

stalls the package
and appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` because `package.json` decl

ares a bundle patch. Restart the
profile afterwards. The reserved `desktop` profile is refused by th

is CLI (`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively
by the Electron application`) — use the desktop ap
p path below for it.
A `file:` install pins a snapshot of this checkout, so re-run the install after a `git pull`; for li

ve development
against the checkout, install `link:C:/src/dsh-keil` instead — edits then apply on th
nst the checkout, install `link:C:/src/dsh-keil` instead — edits then apply on the next DSH restart.
### 2. Desktop app
Use **Settings → Plugins** to install a bundle from the absolute checkout directory, or run the bund

led installer,
which locates the DSH home, the profile and the CLI allowed to write it (the app's ca

rrier CLI for `desktop`, plain
`dsh` otherwise; see AGENTS.md for the manual carrier-CLI commands):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Flags: `--profile <name>` (default: `$DSH_PROFILE`, else `desktop` when it exists, else `web`), `--h

ome <dir>`
(`$DSH_HOME`, else `~/.dsh`), `--repo <dir>` (checkout to install), `--no-ui` (skip `dsh-

better-sidebar`), `--dry-run`
(print commands, write nothing), `--check` (report-only health check,

writes nothing) and `--json` (summary only).
`node scripts/install.mjs --help` is authoritative. Qui
t the app only if pnpm reports the profile as locked.
### 3. Agent-assisted install
Point an AI agent at AGENTS.md: it holds the install, verify and repair runbook, so the agent does n

ot
have to rediscover DSH profile behaviour.
### Verification
`node bin/keil.mjs --help`, `node bin/keil.mjs doctor --compact`, `node bin/keil.mjs show-config` an

d
`node --test test/core.test.mjs` all run from a plain checkout. Once installed, the same CLI is ex

posed as `dsh-keil`
in the profile's `node_modules/.bin`.
## Optional dependency behaviour
`dsh-better-sidebar` is the only optional dependency and a UI concern only: the client half register

s its tab inside
`ctx.inject(['betterSidebar'], …)`, so without that service the registration never

runs, the bundle still loads, and
no error is raised.
| Without `dsh-better-sidebar` | With `dsh-better-sidebar` |

| Tool, CLI and `/keil/api` all work | Tool, CLI and `/keil/api` all work |
| No sidebar tab, no war
ning | A **Keil** tab: picker, build buttons, tree, include paths, log |
The host half requires only the `tools` service; `webServer` is optional too, so a headless or TUI p

rofile keeps the
tool and the CLI but has no panel and no HTTP route.
## Configuring UV4
`UV4.exe` is looked up once per machine, first hit wins:
| Order | Source | Details |
| 1 | Environment | `DSH_KEIL_UV4`, then `KEIL_UV4`; the value may be the exe, the `UV4` folder or t

he Keil root |
| 2 | Config file | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\keil\config.json` → `{"uv4": "C:\\Keil_v5\\UV

4\\UV4.exe"}` |
| 3 | Registry | `HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Keil\Products\MDK`, `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Keil\

Products\MDK`, `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Keil\Products\MDK` — the `Path` value and its parents |
